notes.title: Bad Faith is ONE YEAR OLD!
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FltF9g7WQAMQG_f?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

[h1][b]Can you believe it?! 

[i]Bad Faith[/i] is now one year old![/b]
[/h1]

Time's really flown by... I'm really happy you've all enjoyed playing my visual novel as much as I've enjoyed making it.

To celebrate - I've prepped three [i]Bad Faith[/i] related goodies for you...

[h3][u][b]
First - [i]Bad Faith's[/i] DEMO is now available in German![/b][/u][/h3]

With the help of [url=https://mimir-translations.itch.io/]Mimir Translations[/url], I've worked behind the scenes to produce [b]a new German localization for [i]Bad Faith's[/i] DEMO.[/b] If this translation is well-received, the whole game will be localized. 

This update also has several QOL updates for the DEMO that were present in the final game; such as the preview textbox in the Preferences menu and the tooltip text for the in-game quick menu.

You can download the new version of [i]Bad Faith's[/i] DEMO now!

[h3][url=https://madocallie.itch.io/badfaith/devlog/468841/bad-faith-the-postmortem]Second - I've written a postmortem for [i]Bad Faith![/i][/url][/h3]

[i]Click the link above to read my postmortem. [/i]

Here, you'll see my thoughts on the game one year on; from what I enjoyed to what I thought I could've improved on. Additionally, I'll discuss [i]Bad Faith's[/i] future, and other stories I want to tell...

[h3][url=https://www.dropbox.com/home/Bad%20Faith%20Sprite%20.psds]Third - I've uploaded .psds of [i]Bad Faith's [/i]character sprites![/url][/h3]

[i]Click the link above to access the files.[/i]

If you've ever wondered how I've made my character sprites for the game, now's your chance to study them! 

Feel free to play around with them too; I'd love to see what memes you make...

[h3][u][b]Additionally, between January 9th-January 16th, [i]Bad Faith [/i]will be 25% off.[/b][/u][/h3]

If you've wanted to get a copy of [i]Bad Faith [/i]for yourself, mark your calendars for these dates!

I'll be very vocal about this once the sale rolls around, but I wanted to give you all a week-long heads-up to get prepared.

[h3][b]Thank you all for the incredible amount of support for [i]Bad Faith. [/i]

I hope you enjoy these goodies, and I'll see you in the future![/b][/h3]

[h2][b]-Mado[/b][/h2]
